recipes.name: Classic beef & vegetable shepherd's pie
recipes.blurb: Savory minced beef under a craggy mash lid, baked until the edges bubble gold.
steps: Peel and quarter the potatoes, then boil in salted water for 15-18 minutes until tender.
Meanwhile, heat the oil and brown the beef in a wide pan over high heat, breaking it up, about 6 minutes.
Add diced onion and carrot and cook 5 minutes, then stir in tomato paste, worcestershire and stock. Simmer 12 minutes until thickened, folding in the peas at the end.
Drain the potatoes and mash with butter and warm milk until smooth, then season.
Spoon the beef into a baking dish, top with mash and rough up the surface with a fork.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Creamy chicken & mushroom pot pie
recipes.blurb: Tender chicken in a velvety sauce, capped with shatteringly crisp puff pastry.
steps: Cut chicken into bite-size pieces. Melt butter and sweat diced onion and carrot for 5 minutes.
Add chicken and sliced mushrooms and cook until the chicken is sealed and the mushrooms release their liquid, about 8 minutes.
Stir in the flour and thyme and cook 1 minute, then gradually pour in the stock, stirring to a smooth sauce.
Simmer 10 minutes, stir in the cream, season well and tip into a pie dish to cool slightly.
Lay the puff pastry over the filling, trim, crimp the edges and cut a small steam vent. Brush with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C for 25-30 minutes until the pastry is deeply golden and puffed.

recipes.name: Baked ziti with sausage
recipes.blurb: Layers of pasta, fennel-spiked sausage ragu and three cheeses baked into one bubbling tray.
steps: Boil the ziti in salted water for 2 minutes less than the package says, then drain.
Brown the sausage out of its casings in oil, breaking it up, then add diced onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and oregano, season and simmer 15 minutes.
Fold the pasta and ricotta through the sauce, then tip half into a baking dish.
Scatter half the mozzarella, add the rest of the pasta and finish with remaining mozzarella and the parmesan.
Bake at 190C for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling. Rest 10 minutes before serving.

recipes.name: Beef chili con carne
recipes.blurb: A deep, smoky pot of beef and beans that only gets better the next day.
steps: Brown the beef in oil over high heat, breaking it up well, then set aside.
In the same pot soften diced onion, pepper and garlic for 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder, cumin and paprika and toast for 1 minute until fragrant.
Return the beef, add tomatoes, drained beans and stock, then bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered on low for 40 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick and glossy. Season to taste.

recipes.name: Sausage & root vegetable traybake
recipes.blurb: Everything roasts on one sheet until the sausages blister and the veg caramelize.
steps: Cut the potatoes, carrots and onions into chunks and toss in a large roasting tray with the oil, rosemary and seasoning.
Roast at 200C for 15 minutes to get a head start.
Nestle the sausages and apple wedges among the veg and brush everything with the mustard.
Roast a further 25-30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are browned and the veg are tender and caramelized.
Serve straight from the tray.

recipes.name: Tuna noodle casserole
recipes.blurb: A nostalgic creamy bake with a crunchy crumb top that disappears fast.
steps: Cook the noodles in salted water until just shy of done, then drain.
Melt the butter and soften diced onion and sliced mushrooms for 6 minutes.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then whisk in the milk and simmer to a smooth sauce. Stir in most of the cheese.
Fold in the noodles, drained tuna and peas, season and tip into a baking dish.
Top with breadcrumbs and remaining cheese.
Bake at 190C for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Vegetarian lasagna
recipes.blurb: Roasted vegetables layered with bechamel and tomato for a generous meatless tray.
steps: Dice the zucchini, eggplant and peppers, toss with oil and roast at 220C for 25 minutes until soft and charred at the edges.
Simmer the roasted veg with the tomatoes, garlic and oregano for 15 minutes, then season.
For the bechamel, melt the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then add the milk and cook to a smooth sauce. Stir in half the parmesan.
Layer tomato-veg, lasagna sheets and bechamel in a dish, repeating and finishing with bechamel.
Scatter the remaining parmesan over the top.
Bake at 190C for 35-40 minutes until golden and set. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: Roast chicken with lemon & herbs
recipes.blurb: A bronzed Sunday bird perfumed with lemon and thyme, juices for gravy underneath.
steps: Pat the chicken dry and let it sit at room temperature 20 minutes. Halve the lemon and the garlic head.
Scatter onion and carrot chunks in a roasting tray as a bed. Sit the chicken on top.
Stuff the cavity with the lemon, half the garlic and the thyme. Rub the skin with oil and season generously.
Roast at 200C for about 1 hour 20 minutes, basting once, until the juices run clear and a thigh reaches 75C.
Rest the chicken 15 minutes under foil, then carve and serve with the pan juices.

recipes.name: Macaroni & cheese bake
recipes.blurb: A proper baked mac with a sharp cheddar sauce and a golden crumb crust.
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the package time, then drain.
Melt the butter, whisk in the flour and cook 1 minute, then gradually add the milk to make a smooth sauce.
Off the heat stir in most of the cheese, the mustard, nutmeg and salt until glossy.
Fold in the macaroni and tip into a baking dish.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the remaining cheese and scatter over the top.
Bake at 200C for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Chicken & rice casserole
recipes.blurb: A hands-off one-dish bake where the rice cooks in seasoned stock under the chicken.
steps: Season the chicken with paprika, salt and pepper. Brown skin-side down in oil in an oven dish, then remove.
Soften diced onion, carrot and garlic in the same dish for 6 minutes.
Stir in the rice to coat, then pour in the hot stock and bring to a simmer.
Sit the chicken on top, skin up, and cover tightly with foil.
Bake at 190C for 35 minutes, then uncover and bake 15 minutes more until the rice is tender and the skin crisp. Rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Hearty beef stew
recipes.blurb: Slow-braised chuck and root vegetables in a rich, wine-deepened gravy.
steps: Cut the beef into large chunks, toss with the flour and a little salt, then brown in batches in oil. Set aside.
Soften the onions in the pot, stir in the tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Pour in the wine and scrape the base, letting it reduce by half.
Return the beef, add stock and bay, bring to a simmer, then cover and cook low for 1 hour 30 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook a further 40 minutes until the meat is fork-tender and the gravy is rich.
Discard the bay, season and serve.

recipes.name: Cheesy broccoli & rice bake
recipes.blurb: A comforting meatless casserole that turns a head of broccoli into dinner.
steps: Cook the rice in the stock until just done, then set aside.
Soften diced onion and garlic in the butter for 5 minutes, then stir in the milk and warm through.
Off the heat add most of the cheese and season to make a loose sauce.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 2 minutes, then fold into the rice with the cheese sauce.
Tip into a baking dish and top with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 190C for 25 minutes until golden and set.

recipes.name: Pork & apple traybake
recipes.blurb: Juicy pork chops roasted with sweet apples, onions and a touch of cider.
steps: Halve the potatoes, toss with oil and salt and roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
Add the onion wedges and apple wedges to the tray and nestle the seasoned pork chops among them.
Whisk the cider with the mustard and sage and pour over.
Roast for 20-25 minutes until the pork is cooked through and the apples are soft.
Rest the pork briefly, then serve with the pan juices spooned over.

recipes.name: Three-bean vegetarian chili
recipes.blurb: A smoky meat-free chili thick with beans, peppers and a hit of chipotle.
steps: Soften diced onion, peppers and garlic in oil for 7 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder and chopped chipotle and toast 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and all the drained beans with a splash of water.
Simmer uncovered for 30 minutes until thick, mashing a few beans to thicken.
Season and serve with your favorite toppings.

recipes.name: Stuffed bell peppers
recipes.blurb: Sweet peppers filled with savory beef and rice, baked until tender and bronzed.
steps: Slice the tops off the peppers and remove the seeds. Stand them in a baking dish.
Brown the beef in oil, add diced onion and garlic and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in half the tomatoes, the cooked rice and oregano, then season.
Spoon the filling into the peppers and pour the remaining tomatoes around the base.
Cover with foil and bake at 190C for 30 minutes.
Uncover, top with mozzarella and bake 10 minutes more until the peppers are tender and the cheese melts.

recipes.name: Fish pie with cheddar mash
recipes.blurb: Flaky white fish and salmon in a creamy parsley sauce under a cheesy mash blanket.
steps: Boil the peeled, chopped potatoes until tender, then mash with a third of the butter and a splash of the milk. Season.
Poach the fish gently in the remaining milk for 4 minutes, then lift out, flake and reserve the milk.
Make a sauce: melt the rest of the butter, whisk in the flour for 1 minute, then add the poaching milk to a smooth sauce. Stir in chopped parsley.
Fold the flaked fish and peas through the sauce and tip into a baking dish.
Spread the mash on top and fork the surface, then scatter with cheddar.
Bake at 200C for 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbling.

recipes.name: Lentil & vegetable cottage pie
recipes.blurb: A meat-free take on the classic: spiced lentils under a fluffy mash crown.
steps: Boil the lentils in plenty of water for 20 minutes until just tender, then drain.
Soften diced onion, carrot and mushrooms in 1 tbsp oil for 8 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock, thyme and soy and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Meanwhile boil the peeled, chopped potatoes until tender and mash with the remaining oil and seasoning.
Spoon the lentil mixture into a baking dish and top with the mash, roughing up the surface.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until the top is golden.

recipes.name: Big-batch minestrone soup
recipes.blurb: A garden of vegetables, beans and pasta in a brothy pot built to feed a crowd.
steps: Soften diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, oregano and stock and bring to a boil.
Stir in the diced zucchini and drained beans and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and shredded kale and cook a further 10 minutes until the pasta is tender.
Season to taste. Cool fully before portioning; it keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes well without the pasta.

recipes.name: Chickpea & spinach curry
recipes.blurb: A fragrant, freezer-friendly curry that comes together from mostly pantry staples.
steps: Soften diced onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder and cumin and toast 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and drained chickpeas and simmer 20 minutes.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and season to taste.
Cool and portion. Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Slow-cooker pulled pork
recipes.blurb: Spice-rubbed shoulder braised until it shreds with a fork, ready for a week of meals.
steps: Mix the paprika, brown sugar, cumin, garlic powder and salt and rub all over the pork.
Lay sliced onion in the slow cooker and sit the pork on top.
Pour in the stock and vinegar around the sides.
Cook on low for 8 hours until the meat is meltingly tender.
Lift out the pork, shred with two forks and stir back through some of the cooking juices.
Portion for the week; it keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Freezer breakfast burritos
recipes.blurb: Make a dozen at once: eggs, beans and cheese rolled tight and frozen for grab-and-go mornings.
steps: Soften diced pepper and onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the drained beans and cumin to warm through.
Whisk the eggs and scramble gently in the same pan until just set, then fold in the veg.
Lay out each tortilla, add a line of egg, a spoon of salsa and a scatter of cheese.
Fold in the sides and roll up tightly into burritos.
Wrap each in foil or parchment and freeze. Reheat from frozen in a 180C oven for 25 minutes or microwave 2-3 minutes.

recipes.name: Batch turkey & quinoa meatballs
recipes.blurb: Lean baked meatballs bulked with quinoa that freeze beautifully for fast dinners.
steps: Grate the onion and garlic into a bowl with the turkey, cooked quinoa, egg, chopped parsley, oregano and salt.
Mix gently with your hands until just combined.
Roll into 24 even meatballs and place on an oiled baking tray.
Bake at 200C for 22-25 minutes until browned and cooked through (74C internal).
Cool fully, then refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze in batches up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Roasted vegetable & feta grain bowl base
recipes.blurb: A big tray of roasted veg and a pot of farro to mix and match into bowls all week.
steps: Cook the farro in salted water until tender, about 25 minutes, then drain.
Cube the sweet potato and zucchini and cut the onion into wedges. Toss with oil, oregano and salt.
Roast at 220C for 25 minutes, adding the cherry tomatoes for the last 10 minutes.
Store the farro and roasted veg separately in containers.
To assemble a bowl, combine farro and veg and crumble over feta. Components keep 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Smoky black bean soup
recipes.blurb: A thick, velvety pot of black beans with cumin and lime that only improves on day two.
steps: Soften diced onion, pepper and garlic in the oil for 7 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and paprika and toast 1 minute.
Add the drained beans and stock and simmer 20 minutes.
Blend about half the soup for a creamy texture, then return it to the pot.
Finish with a squeeze of lime and season. Keeps 4 days refrigerated; freezes well.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chicken & broccoli meal-prep
recipes.blurb: Marinated chicken and broccoli roast together for five tidy lunch boxes.
steps: Cut the chicken into even strips and toss with 2 tbsp oil, minced garlic, paprika, oregano, lemon juice and salt.
Spread on a sheet pan and roast at 220C for 12 minutes.
Toss the broccoli florets with the remaining oil and salt, add to the pan and roast 12-15 minutes more until the chicken is cooked (74C).
Cool, then divide between five containers.
Keeps 4 days refrigerated; reheat gently to keep the chicken juicy.

recipes.name: Big-batch bolognese sauce
recipes.blurb: A deep, slow-simmered ragu made in volume to portion and freeze for easy pasta nights.
steps: Finely chop the onion, carrot, celery and garlic and soften in the oil for 10 minutes.
Add the beef and brown well over high heat, breaking it up.
Stir in the tomato paste, then pour in the wine and let it reduce by half.
Add the tomatoes, stock and oregano, bring to a simmer and cook low for 90 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season to taste. Cool, then portion; refrigerate 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Coconut chickpea & sweet potato stew
recipes.blurb: A creamy, golden one-pot stew that batch-cooks and freezes like a dream.
steps: Soften diced onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic and ginger and cook 1 minute.
Stir in the curry powder, then add the diced sweet potato, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Add the drained chickpeas, bring to a simmer and cook 25 minutes until the sweet potato is tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and season.
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Baked teriyaki salmon meal-prep
recipes.blurb: Glazed salmon fillets baked with rice and edamame for balanced, ready-to-go boxes.
steps: Cook the rice and set aside. Whisk soy, honey, ginger, garlic, sesame oil and vinegar into a glaze.
Place the salmon on a lined tray and brush generously with half the glaze.
Bake at 200C for 12-14 minutes until just flaking, brushing with more glaze halfway.
Steam or boil the edamame for 4 minutes.
Divide rice, salmon and edamame between four containers; keeps 3 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Hearty lentil soup
recipes.blurb: A frugal, deeply savory pot of lentils and vegetables that feeds the freezer too.
steps: Soften diced onion, carrot, celery and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, then add the lentils, tomatoes and stock.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 30-35 minutes until the lentils are soft.
Blend a little of the soup for body if you like, then finish with lemon juice and seasoning.
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Beef & vegetable freezer stew
recipes.blurb: A make-ahead braise that portions into single meals and keeps for months.
steps: Cut the beef into chunks and brown in batches in the oil, then set aside.
Soften the onions, stir in the tomato paste and cook 2 minutes.
Return the beef with the tomatoes, stock and bay, then simmer covered for 90 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes and cook 40 minutes more until everything is tender.
Thicken with the cornstarch slaked in a little water, then discard the bay.
Cool fully and freeze in single portions up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Mediterranean quinoa salad jars
recipes.blurb: Layered jars of quinoa, chickpeas and crunch that stay crisp until lunch.
steps: Whisk the lemon juice, olive oil and a little salt and spoon into the bottom of four jars.
Layer in the chickpeas, then diced cucumber, tomatoes and red onion so they sit above the dressing.
Add the cooled quinoa and top with crumbled feta and chopped parsley.
Seal and refrigerate up to 4 days.
Shake or tip into a bowl to dress just before eating.

recipes.name: Pulled BBQ jackfruit
recipes.blurb: Shredded jackfruit simmered in smoky-sweet sauce for plant-based sandwich nights.
steps: Drain the jackfruit and pull it apart with your fingers, discarding any tough cores.
Soften diced onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the jackfruit, paprika and cumin and cook 5 minutes, pressing to shred further.
Stir in the BBQ sauce and stock and simmer 20 minutes until thick and saucy.
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes well.

recipes.name: Thai red curry with vegetables
recipes.blurb: A fragrant, big-batch coconut curry loaded with vegetables and tofu.
steps: Press and cube the tofu, then brown in the oil until golden on most sides. Set aside.
Fry the curry paste in the same pan for 1 minute until fragrant.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a gentle simmer.
Add the sliced peppers, zucchini and snap peas and cook 8 minutes until just tender.
Return the tofu, add soy and a squeeze of lime, then season. Keeps 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Baked oatmeal squares
recipes.blurb: A make-ahead tray of cinnamon oats you slice into portable, sliceable breakfasts.
steps: Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then whisk in the milk, eggs and maple syrup.
Stir in the oats, baking powder and cinnamon until combined.
Pour into a lined baking dish and scatter the berries over the top.
Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until set and golden.
Cool, then slice into squares; keeps 4 days refrigerated or freeze individually.

recipes.name: Sweet potato & black bean freezer burritos
recipes.blurb: Hearty vegan burritos with roasted sweet potato and beans, rolled and frozen by the batch.
steps: Cube the sweet potato, toss with 1 tbsp oil and the spices and roast at 220C for 25 minutes.
Soften diced onion in the rest of the oil, then add the drained beans and salsa to warm through.
Mash lightly, then fold in the roasted sweet potato and cooked rice.
Spoon the filling onto each tortilla, fold in the sides and roll up tightly.
Wrap individually and freeze. Reheat from frozen in a 180C oven for 25 minutes.

recipes.name: Moroccan chickpea & vegetable tagine
recipes.blurb: Warmly spiced chickpeas and squash simmered low for a fragrant, batch-friendly stew.
steps: Soften diced onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes.
Stir in the ras el hanout and toast 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the cubed squash, tomatoes, stock and halved apricots.
Add the drained chickpeas and simmer 35 minutes until the squash is tender and the sauce thick.
Season to taste. Keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Honey garlic chicken thighs (batch)
recipes.blurb: Sticky, caramelized thighs baked in volume for ready protein all week.
steps: Whisk the honey, soy, minced garlic, vinegar, paprika and oil into a glaze.
Toss the thighs in the glaze and arrange in a single layer in a baking dish.
Bake at 200C for 30 minutes, basting once with the pan sauce.
Broil 3-4 minutes to caramelize, until sticky and cooked through (74C).
Cool and portion; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes up to 3 months.

recipes.name: Spinach & ricotta egg muffins
recipes.blurb: Crustless mini frittatas baked in a muffin tin for grab-and-go protein.
steps: Wilt the spinach with diced onion in the oil for 4 minutes, then cool slightly.
Whisk the eggs with the parmesan and salt, then stir in the spinach and dollops of ricotta.
Grease a 12-cup muffin tin and divide the mixture between the cups.
Press a halved cherry tomato into each.
Bake at 180C for 18-20 minutes until set and just golden. Cool; keeps 4 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Greek-style baked cod with chickpeas
recipes.blurb: Lean cod roasted over lemony chickpeas and tomatoes for a high-protein one-dish dinner.
steps: Toss the drained chickpeas, tomatoes, sliced onion and garlic with 2 tbsp oil, oregano and salt in a baking dish.
Roast at 200C for 15 minutes to soften.
Nestle the cod fillets among the chickpeas, drizzle with the remaining oil and squeeze over half the lemon.
Roast a further 12-15 minutes until the cod flakes easily.
Finish with the remaining lemon and serve.

recipes.name: Grilled steak with chimichurri
recipes.blurb: Charred steak rested and sliced under a bright, herby chimichurri.
steps: Finely chop the parsley and garlic and stir with the vinegar, oil, chili flakes, oregano and salt to make chimichurri. Set aside.
Pat the steak dry, season well and bring to room temperature.
Grill over high heat for 3-4 minutes per side for medium-rare, depending on thickness.
Rest the steak 5-10 minutes, then slice against the grain.
Spoon the chimichurri generously over the sliced steak.

recipes.name: High-protein cottage cheese pancakes
recipes.blurb: Light, protein-packed pancakes that need no flour and cook up tender.
steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, oats, vanilla, baking powder and cinnamon until smooth.
Let the batter rest 5 minutes to thicken.
Heat a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour small rounds and cook 2-3 minutes until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1-2 minutes more.
Serve warm with fruit or a drizzle of syrup.

recipes.name: Tofu & vegetable stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Crisp tofu and vegetables tossed in a savory ginger-soy glaze in minutes.
steps: Press and cube the tofu, toss with the cornstarch, then fry in the vegetable oil until golden and crisp. Remove.
Stir-fry the broccoli, sliced pepper and carrot over high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and toss for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu, pour in the soy and a splash of water and toss until glossy.
Finish with the sesame oil off the heat and serve at once.

recipes.name: Baked falafel bowl
recipes.blurb: Crisp baked chickpea falafel over greens and grains with a lemony tahini drizzle.
steps: Pulse the drained chickpeas, onion, garlic, parsley, cumin and flour into a coarse mixture that holds together.
Shape into 16 small patties and place on an oiled tray, brushing the tops with oil.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Whisk the tahini with lemon juice and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Pile the greens into bowls, add the falafel and drizzle with the tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Salmon & egg power bowl
recipes.blurb: Flaked salmon, jammy eggs and avocado over greens for a serious protein hit.
steps: Boil the eggs for 7 minutes for jammy yolks, then cool, peel and halve.
Pan-sear the seasoned salmon in 1 tbsp oil, about 4 minutes per side, then flake.
Whisk the remaining oil with lemon juice and salt for a quick dressing.
Arrange the greens, sliced cucumber and avocado in two bowls.
Top with the salmon and eggs and drizzle with the dressing.

recipes.name: Lemon herb baked chicken breast
recipes.blurb: Juicy, never-dry chicken breasts brined briefly and baked for lean protein.
steps: Pound the breasts to an even thickness so they cook uniformly.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, oregano, paprika, salt and pepper into a marinade.
Coat the chicken and let it sit 15 minutes (or overnight).
Bake at 200C for 20-22 minutes until the internal temperature reaches 74C.
Rest 5 minutes before slicing to keep the juices in.

recipes.name: Black bean & turkey high-protein chili
recipes.blurb: A lean, beany chili built around ground turkey for a protein-forward bowl.
steps: Brown the turkey in the oil over high heat, breaking it up well.
Add diced onion, pepper and garlic and cook 6 minutes.
Stir in the chili powder and cumin and toast 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans and stock and simmer 30 minutes until thick.
Season to taste; keeps 4 days refrigerated and freezes well.

recipes.name: Shrimp & broccoli garlic stir-fry
recipes.blurb: Quick-seared shrimp and broccoli in a punchy garlic sauce, light and high in protein.
steps: Pat the shrimp dry and toss with a little of the cornstarch. Mix the rest with the soy, oyster sauce and 100ml water.
Blanch the broccoli florets for 2 minutes, then drain.
Sear the shrimp in 1 tbsp hot oil for 2 minutes until pink, then remove.
Stir-fry the garlic and ginger in the remaining oil for 30 seconds, add the broccoli and toss 2 minutes.
Return the shrimp, pour in the sauce and toss until thickened and glossy. Serve at once.

recipes.name: Greek yogurt chicken salad
recipes.blurb: A lighter, creamy chicken salad bound with yogurt for a protein-rich lunch.
steps: Shred or dice the cooked chicken into a large bowl.
Finely chop the celery, red onion and parsley and add to the bowl.
Stir in the yogurt, mustard and lemon juice.
Season with salt and pepper and mix until evenly coated.
Chill 15 minutes before serving; keeps 3 days refrigerated.

recipes.name: Lentil & egg protein breakfast bowl
recipes.blurb: Spiced lentils topped with a fried egg and greens for a savory, filling start.
steps: Soften diced onion and garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and paprika, then add the drained lentils and warm through.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and finish with lemon juice and seasoning.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil to your liking.
Spoon the lentils into bowls and top each with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Protein-packed white bean tuna salad
recipes.blurb: A no-cook bowl of beans and tuna brightened with lemon for fast, lean protein.
steps: Drain and rinse the beans and tip into a large bowl.
Add the drained tuna, halved tomatoes, thinly sliced onion and chopped parsley.
Whisk the lemon juice, oil and salt into a dressing.
Pour over and toss gently to combine.
Rest 10 minutes for the flavors to meld; keeps 2 days refrigerated.
